Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Active Ability: Unlimited Void

Paradox (Divine Sight) Stops every enemy in their tracks and buffs his damage by 100% for the duration of his domain. If an enemy has already been affected by Timestop less than 10 seconds before use, the enemy will not be stopped in the domain.

  • Global Cooldown: 60
  • Duration: 8

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • For the Six Eyes
    , you must get 6 Rikugan Eyes to form one.
  • His upgrades' costs (not including Limitless upgrades) are the same as Trickster (Release).
  • Limitless 1 costs 3 Rikugan Eyes, while all following Limitless upgrades require more and more Six Eyes (1 Six Eye for Limitless 2, 2 Six Eyes for Limitless 3, 4 Six Eyes for Limitless 4, 5 Six Eyes for Limitless 5, 8 Six Eyes for limitless 6, 12 Six eyes for limitless 7 etc.)
  • Every Limitless upgrade increases Paradox's DMG by 10% of his DMG at Upgrade 9 and costs 1,400¥ more than the previous upgrade.
    • Assuming a 50k Paradox (Divine Sight) at Upgrade 9, Limitless 1 would deal 55,000 (110%) and cost 15,400¥
    • At Limitless 3, Paradox (Divine Sight) would deal 65k (130%) and the upgrade would cost 18,200¥
    • At Limitless 6, Paradox (Divine Sight) would deal 80k (160%) and the upgrade would cost 22,400¥
    • At Limitless 10, Paradox (Divine Sight) would deal 100k (200%) and the upgrade would cost 28,000¥
    • Finally, at Limitless 15, Paradox (Divine Sight) would deal 126k (250%) and the upgrade would cost 35,000¥
  • After Update 14.0.0, Paradox (Divine Sight) has been given the Aqua damage type, along with other units without a second damage type.
